title: From Policy Evaluation to Off-Policy Control: Provable Emergence of In-Context Q-Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.18057v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformers can implement reinforcement-learning algorithms in context, yet how off-policy control emerges within Transformers remains poorly understood. We study Q-learning, a foundational model-free control algorithm that combines off-policy bootstrapping with greedy policy improvement. We prove that a two-layer attention-only Transformer can implement a finite-temperature form of Q-learning, where the temperature $\tau>0$ controls the approximation to greedy action selection, recovering window Q-learning as $\tau\to0$. We train the structured Transformer on randomly generated MDP tasks using output-only supervision. Experiments show that the theoretically predicted parameter structure emerges during training, including the internal greedy action-selection mechanism, and that the trained Transformer achieves performance comparable to Q-learning on unseen tasks. translated_title: 从策略评估到离策略控制：上下文Q学习的可证明涌现
translated_abstract: Transformer能够在上下文中实现强化学习算法，然而离策略控制在Transformer内部如何涌现仍知之甚少。我们研究Q学习——一种基础的无模型控制算法，它将离策略自举与贪婪策略改进相结合。我们证明了一个两层的仅注意力Transformer可以实现有限温度形式的Q学习，其中温度参数 $\tau>0$ 控制对贪婪动作选择的近似程度，且当 $\tau\to0$ 时可恢复为窗口Q学习。我们使用仅输出监督在随机生成的MDP任务上训练该结构化Transformer。实验表明，理论预测的参数结构（包括内部的贪婪动作选择机制）在训练过程中确实涌现，且训练后的Transformer在未见过的任务上取得了与Q学习相当的性能。我们的理论分析进一步表明，其等价实现……
tldr: 本文证明了两层仅注意力Transformer能够实现有限温度形式的Q学习，并通过实验验证了理论预测的参数结构（包括内部贪婪动作选择机制）会在训练中自然涌现，使训练后的Transformer在未见任务上达到与Q学习相当的性能。
